summary: Steep residential street lined with houses and No Stopping signs.
reasons: Homes within 2-24 m the whole way

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes sit 2-24 m from the kerb along the full 208 m; nowhere backs onto bush or open ground.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow winding street with steep sides and driveways; little clear ground beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, meeting a busier road at the far end.
drivers.convention: A few cars park near the junction at 190-208 m, but signs there say No Stopping Any Time.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs at both mapped points
Several dwellings under 10 m from the kerb
sun_shade: Mixed tree shade from the south side; houses shade the north side.
